cases.rationale: Efficiency signals with external evidence and no user complaint: repeated identical gate runs, a re-derived fact, a manual step a tool command covers, and an oversized model for lookups.

cases.source: Separately authored synthetic fixture, 2026-10-29. RE02 follows an observed case in which per-session cache savings did not hold in the aggregate.
cases.rationale: A cost claim from hand-picked session pairs must not become a default; cost and quota need an aggregate.
Digest lines and Flow friction lines are candidate evidence; same-task lines count once and an unsupported line is rejected.
A slow gate that catches real defects is kept; a gate that only produced false positives may be repaired or relaxed with that evidence.
Long sessions, many tool calls and required gate time without a measured avoidable cost are not friction.
Before-and-after tracking of accepted efficiency changes, including a quality cost and missing measurements.
